description: Returns a list of all Meetings for a specified Project.

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Returns meeting(s) with the specified ID(s)

parameters.name: filters[assignee_id]
parameters.description: Returns meeting(s) with the specified assignee

parameters.name: filters[title]
parameters.description: Returns meeting(s) with parts of title matching the specified string

parameters.name: filters[public]
parameters.description: Filter by visibility. Pass `true` to return only public meetings or `false` for private meetings. Value is a boolean string.

parameters.name: filters[draft]
parameters.description: Filter by draft state. Pass `true` to return only draft meetings or `false` for finalized meetings. Value is a boolean string.

parameters.name: filter[root_id]
parameters.description: Returns child meeting(s) whose root_id matches the specified root_id. Parent is returned as well

parameters.name: filters[template_id]
parameters.description: Returns child meeting(s) whose meeting_template_id matches the specified template_id.

parameters.name: filters[from]
parameters.description: Returns meeting(s) started at a date >= specified date

parameters.name: filters[to]
parameters.description: Returns meeting(s) started at a date <= specified date

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: The data set that should be returned from the serializer. Default view is `default`. The `mobile` view is reserved for Procore mobile clients (identified by the `Procore-OSName` header); requesting...

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort results by the specified field. Add a "-" prefix for descending order (e.g., -created_at).

422.description: Unprocessable Entity (e.g. the `mobile` view was requested by a non-mobile client)
